Rank evaluated replication-state parameters

Source: R/tune_states.R
rank_state_parameters.Rd

Keep the successful rows of evaluate_state_parameters() and order them by decreasing target_prop_all_cells, target_prop_non_missing and pass_qc_prop, then by increasing distance_to_current (sum of absolute differences to reference) and finally by the parameter columns named in reference (increasing). NA values sort last.

Usage

rank_state_parameters(results, reference)

Arguments

results

Output of evaluate_state_parameters().

reference

Named numeric vector (or list) of the current parameter values. We use c(init_ratio_lower = 1.2, final_ratio_lower = 1.4).

Value

results restricted to status == "ok", with a distance_to_current column, in ranked order. An error is raised if no row succeeded.
